Container.Name: qbt-slowban
Container.Overview: Sidecar helper for hotio/qbittorrent. Warns after 45 seconds below the minimum upload-speed threshold, bans after 90 seconds, clears the manual ban list every 12 hours, writes 2-hour logs with 7 days retention, and emits a 10-minute summary.

Config.Name: App Script
Config.Description: Path to slowban.py on Unraid

Config.Name: State Directory
Config.Description: Persistent state directory

Config.Name: Log Directory
Config.Description: Directory for 2-hour log files

Config.Name: QBT_URL
Config.Description: qBittorrent WebUI URL. Change this to your qBittorrent address.

Config.Name: QBT_USERNAME
Config.Description: qBittorrent username

Config.Name: QBT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: qBittorrent password

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_THRESHOLD_TIME
Config.Description: Seconds a peer may stay below the minimum speed before ban

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_WARN_TIME
Config.Description: Seconds below threshold before logging a warning

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_MIN_SPEED
Config.Description: Minimum upload speed in bytes per second

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_POLL_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Polling interval in seconds

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_SUMMARY_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Summary log interval in seconds

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_CLEAR_PERIODICALLY
Config.Description: Cron schedule to clear all manual bans every 12 hours

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_BANNED_PEERS
Config.Description: Comma-separated peers to keep permanently banned

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, BAN, UNBAN, ERROR

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_DRY_RUN
Config.Description: If true, only simulate bans and ban-list changes

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_STATE_FILE
Config.Description: Path to persistent state file inside container

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_LOG_DIR
Config.Description: In-container log directory

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Delete 2-hour log files older than this many days

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_LOG_UNBAN_DETAILS
Config.Description: If true, log each individual peer unbanned during scheduled clears

Config.Name: SLOWBAN_COLOR_LOGS
Config.Description: Enable colored console log output
